{{small|(14 March 2020)}} | attendance = 352,344 | average attendance = 13,552 | prevseason = [[2019 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|2019]] | nextseason = [[2021–22 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|2021–22]] }} The '''2020 Liga 1''', also known as '''Shopee Liga 1''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web |title=Emtek Kembali Jadi Official Broadcaster Liga 1 2020 |url=https://www.liputan6.com/bola/read/4171490/emtek-kembali-jadi-official-broadcaster-liga-1-2020 |website=liputan6.com |access-date=5 February 2020 |language=id |date=5 February 2020}} was the 4th season of [[Liga 1 (Indonesia)|Liga 1]] under its current name and the 11th season of the top-flight Indonesian professional league for [[association football]] clubs since its establishment in 2008. The season started on 29 February 2020 and was suspended on 16 March 2020 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |last1=Prasatya |first1=Randy |title=Gusti Randa: Liga 1 2020 Kick-off 29 Februari |url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-4868252/gusti-randa-liga-1-2020-kick-off-29-februari |website=sepakbola |access-date=22 January 2020 |language=id-ID}}{{cite web |title=PSSI Jalani Instruksi Pemerintah |url=https://www.pssi.org/news/pssi-jalani-instruksi-pemerintah |website=PSSI - Football Association of Indonesia |access-date=22 March 2020 |language=id-ID |archive-date=27 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127210731/https://www.pssi.org/news/pssi-jalani-instruksi-pemerintah |url-status=dead }}{{cite web |last1=Baru |first1=PT Liga Indonesia |title=Terkait Status Kompetisi, LIB Mendukung Penuh Keputusan PSSI |url=https://liga-indonesia.id/news/detail/Terkait-Status-Kompetisi--LIB-Mendukung-Penuh-Keputusan-PSSI |website=liga-indonesia.id |access-date=28 March 2020 |language=en |archive-date=28 March 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200328011304/https://liga-indonesia.id/news/detail/Terkait-Status-Kompetisi--LIB-Mendukung-Penuh-Keputusan-PSSI |url-status=usurped }} The season was abandoned and declared void on 20 January 2021.{{cite web |title=Kompetisi Liga 1 dan 2 Musim 2020-2021 Resmi Dibatalkan |url=https://www.pssi.org/news/kompetisi-liga-1-dan-2-musim-2020-2021-resmi-dibatalkan |website=PSSI - Football Association of Indonesia |access-date=20 January 2021 |language=id-ID |archive-date=27 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210127200121/https://www.pssi.org/news/kompetisi-liga-1-dan-2-musim-2020-2021-resmi-dibatalkan |url-status=dead }} [[Bali United F.C.|Bali United]] were the defending champions. [[Persik Kediri|Persik]], [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]], and [[Persiraja Banda Aceh|Persiraja]] joined as the promoted teams from the [[2019 Liga 2]].{{cite web |title=Ini Tiga Tim yang Berhak Promosi ke Liga 1 2020 : Okezone Bola |url=https://bola.okezone.com/read/2019/11/25/49/2134275/ini-tiga-tim-yang-berhak-promosi-ke-liga-1-2020 |website=Okezone Bola |access-date=26 November 2019 |language=id-ID |date=25 November 2019}} They replace [[Badak Lampung F.C.|Badak Lampung]], [[Kalteng Putra F.C.|Kalteng Putra]], and [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]] who were relegated to the [[2020 Liga 2]].{{cite web |title=Hasil Liga 1: Semen Padang dan Badak Lampung Degradasi |url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20191213202553-142-456883/hasil-liga-1-semen-padang-dan-badak-lampung-degradasi |website=olahraga |access-date=13 December 2019 |language=en}} == Effects of the COVID-19 pandemic == The season was first suspended on 15 March 2020 after finishing matchday three amid increasing contagion risks from the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. The initial plan was the suspension would end in late March. However, the suspension was extended to 29 May 2020 due to government restrictions on social gatherings.{{cite web |title=Kemenpora dan PSSI Hentikan Liga 1 dan Liga 2 karena Virus Corona |url=https://www.indosport.com/sepakbola/20200314/kemenpora-dan-pssi-hentikan-liga-1-dan-liga-2-karena-virus-corona |website=INDOSPORT.com |access-date=14 March 2020 |language=en |date=14 March 2020}} On 27 June 2020, the Indonesian football association, [[PSSI]], announced it would resume Liga 1 from October 2020.{{cite web |title=PSSI Keluarkan Surat Keputusan Lanjutkan Kembali Kompetisi Liga |url=https://www.pssi.org/news/pssi-keluarkan-surat-keputusan-lanjutkan-kembali-kompetisi-liga |website=PSSI - Football Association of Indonesia |access-date=28 June 2020 |language=id-ID |archive-date=28 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200628212559/https://www.pssi.org/news/pssi-keluarkan-surat-keputusan-lanjutkan-kembali-kompetisi-liga |url-status=dead }} League organizer PT Liga Indonesia Baru (LIB) followed it up by announcing matchday four would be held on 1 October 2020 and the season would end on 28 February 2021, but with a note that this tentative schedule would need approval from authorities related to the management of the COVID-19 pandemic. The plan was to hold all matches without spectators and have no changes to the double round-robin format. Organizers were prepared to hold all matches on the main island of [[Java]], where most teams are based, to mitigate contagion risks. Teams from outside Java and the capital Jakarta, which had the highest infection risks in the country, would be based in [[Special Region of Yogyakarta|Yogyakarta]], where the pandemic was relatively under control.{{cite web |title=RESMI: Liga 1 Dilanjutkan 1 Oktober 2020 {{!}} Goal.com |url=https://www.goal.com/id/berita/resmi-liga-1-dilanjutkan-1-oktober-2020/egrg6o2sr7mi1jajj9llcnifb |website=goal.com |access-date=10 July 2020}}{{cite web |title=Liga 1 2020 Dilanjutkan, Penoton Dilarang Hadir ke Stadion |url=https://www.indosport.com/sepakbola/20200710/liga-1-2020-dilanjutkan-penoton-dilarang-hadir-ke-stadion |website=INDOSPORT.com |access-date=10 July 2020 |language=en |date=10 July 2020}} In a 17 July 2020 meeting, all teams agreed on further details for the resumption plan, including increasing substitutions from three to five, in line with a proposal by [[FIFA]] to lessen the impact of fixture congestion. The meeting also agreed that there would be no relegation and all teams must have a minimum of two U-20 local players. To mitigate infection risks, each team must conduct a swab test before the resumption and a rapid test every 14 days during the competition with LIB in charge of testing the day before matchday. LIB also would allow mid-season transfers between 21 September – 18 October 2020 but the transfers would not be recorded at FIFA Transfer Match System (TMS) to avoid conflict with FIFA regulations.{{cite web |title=Inilah Hasil Pertemuan PT LIB dengan Klub Liga 1 {{!}} Official Persib Web |url=https://persib.co.id/berita/inilah-hasil-pertemuan-pt-lib-dengan-klub-liga-1 |website=persib.co.id |access-date=19 July 2020}}{{cite web |title=Bursa Transfer Liga 1 Dibuka Hari Ini {{!}} Goal.com |url=https://www.goal.com/id/berita/bursa-transfer-liga-1-dibuka-hari-ini/2i9w8o5l860e1p9szcwcrlib4 |website=goal.com |access-date=21 September 2020}} The plan began to crumble in September. On 29 September 2020, PSSI postponed the resumption of [[Liga 1 (Indonesia)|Liga 1]] and [[Liga 2 (Indonesia)|Liga 2]] for a month after failing to obtain permission from the police on fears that unruly fans would crowd outside the stadiums. After a month, on 29 October 2020, PSSI announced police had not changed their mind and declared the competition could not be held in 2020.{{cite web |title=Resmi, Liga 1 dan 2 2020 Ditunda Satu Bulan |url=https://www.indosport.com/sepakbola/20200929/resmi-liga-1-dan-2-2020-ditunda-satu-bulan |website=INDOSPORT.com |access-date=29 September 2020 |language=en |date=29 September 2020}}{{cite web |title=Kompetisi Liga 1 dan 2 Batal Digelar Tahun Ini |url=https://republika.co.id/berita/qiyd9a438/kompetisi-liga-1-dan-2-batal-digelar-tahun-ini |website=Republika Online |access-date=29 October 2020 |language=id |date=29 October 2020}} In November 2020, LIB made another attempt to resume the 2020 season in February 2021 with a plan to finish in July 2021. Police also blocked this plan. Eventually, on 15 January 2021, PSSI dismissed the 2020 season of Liga 1 and Liga 2 football leagues and declared them void of winners, relegations and promotions. Any resumption of professional football will be considered as a fresh start of a season.{{cite web |title=RESMI: Digelar 2021, Liga 1 Tetap Pakai Titel Musim 2020 {{!}} Goal.com |url=https://www.goal.com/id/berita/resmi-digelar-2021-liga-1-tetap-pakai-titel-musim-2020/b7t179od188p1mmdzpkpm0i80 |website=www.goal.com |access-date=3 November 2020}}{{cite web |title=Resmi! PSSI Bubarkan Liga 1 2020 |url=https://bola.okezone.com/read/2021/01/20/51/2347835/resmi-pssi-bubarkan-liga-1-2020 |website=Okezone|access-date=20 January 2021 |language=id-ID}} The inability to finish the 2020 season impacted Indonesia's participation in the [[2021 AFC Cup]] competition. Representatives had to be determined by the results of the previous domestic season. [[Bali United]], the [[2019 Liga 1]] champions, was appointed as the first representative. The second appointment was not as straightforward. [[PSM Makassar|PSM]], the [[2018–19 Piala Indonesia]] winners, should have taken the spot but they failed to obtain an AFC license that is required for the hosting of an AFC match. The next on the pecking order was [[Persebaya Surabaya|Persebaya]], the 2019 Liga 1 runner-up, but they also missed the AFC hosting qualifications. As a result, [[Persipura Jayapura|Persipura]], the league third place, qualified to take the second AFC Cup slot for Indonesia.{{cite web |title=AFC Ingin Wakil Indonesia Sesuai Entri Manual Club Competition 2021 |url=https://www.pssi.org/news/afc-ingin-wakil-indonesia-sesuai-entri-manual-club-competition-2021 |website=PSSI - Football Association of Indonesia |access-date=20 December 2020 |language=id-ID |archive-date=31 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210131100227/https://www.pssi.org/news/afc-ingin-wakil-indonesia-sesuai-entri-manual-club-competition-2021 |url-status=dead }} == Teams == Eighteen teams competed in the league – the top fifteen teams from the previous season and the three teams promoted from the [[2019 Liga 2|Liga 2]].
